actions.mechanism: Group matching file hashes only within the same license record; preserve every member’s identity and metadata.
actions.implementation: Add expandable search groups with copy counts, creator IDs, and folder paths. Keep different licenses and explicitly marked intentional variants separate.
actions.check: Test matching hashes with shared and different licenses, plus identical pixels in differently encoded files. Only eligible groups collapse.
actions.risk: Hashes miss visually identical files with different encodings; this conservative behavior is intentional.

actions.action: Record intentional version relationships without hiding variants
actions.mechanism: Explicit relationships distinguish crops, annotations, and licensed copies without treating visual resemblance as interchangeability.
actions.implementation: Provide reversible “crop of,” “annotated from,” and “licensed copy of” links between asset IDs. Display linked variants as separate searchable results.
actions.check: Link two crops to one original and add an annotated version. Confirm all remain individually discoverable and links can be removed.
actions.risk: Incorrect manual links can mislead; retain authorship and correction history.

actions.action: Record the exact licensed file each project used
actions.mechanism: Project usage records bind an asset identity and content hash to its license record, independently of search grouping.
actions.implementation: On asset insertion or export, record project ID, asset ID, hash, license-record version, and timestamp. Resolve historical usage to that specific file.
actions.check: Use identical-pixel files with different licenses in two projects. Each project must retrieve its own file and recorded license.
actions.risk: Uninstrumented workflows leave gaps; label unknown historical usage rather than infer it.

actions.action: Serve grouped results directly from the existing index
actions.mechanism: Indexed grouping fields and bounded result payloads avoid request-time file inspection and relationship traversal.
actions.implementation: Index duplicate-group keys, copy counts, and variant flags. Fetch member details only on expansion; exclude thumbnails from blocking first-page rendering.
actions.check: Benchmark cold and warm first-page loads across representative queries and expected concurrency on all 12,000 assets; require each measured load below one second.
actions.risk: Index lag can misstate groups; invalidate affected entries when licenses or relationships change.
